problem_statement:
The package `stats` has three functions that return wrong results:

- mean.mean(xs) divides by the wrong number and is off for every input.
- median.median(xs) gives wrong answers when the list is not already sorted, and for even-length lists it must return the average of the two middle values.
- mode.mode(xs) must return the most frequent value; when several values tie, it must return the smallest of them. Right now it returns the first value it sees.

Fix all three. Do not change their names or signatures.
patch:
diff --git a/stats/mean.py b/stats/mean.py
index 47aabeb..cbc9a4f 100644
--- a/stats/mean.py
+++ b/stats/mean.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def mean(xs):
-    return sum(xs) / (len(xs) - 1)
+    return sum(xs) / len(xs)
diff --git a/stats/median.py b/stats/median.py
index bd5c558..524f17c 100644
--- a/stats/median.py
+++ b/stats/median.py
@@ -1,2 +1,5 @@
 def median(xs):
-    return xs[len(xs) // 2]
+    s = sorted(xs)
+    n = len(s)
+    mid = n // 2
+    return s[mid] if n % 2 else (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
diff --git a/stats/mode.py b/stats/mode.py
index 6c6d757..67fd65f 100644
--- a/stats/mode.py
+++ b/stats/mode.py
@@ -1,6 +1,2 @@
 def mode(xs):
-    best = xs[0]
-    for x in xs:
-        if xs.count(x) > xs.count(best):
-            best = x
-    return best
+    return min(xs, key=lambda x: (-xs.count(x), x))
